institution.name: Vaughn College of Aeronautics and Technology

plan.notes: Source: official Vaughn College curriculum sheet 'AIRCRAFT OPERATIONS (DAOF) - Associate in Applied Science (AAS) (Fall/2019 - Spring/2021)', Rev.07/19 (vaughn.edu), transcribed exactly: four semesters (17/17/15/15) = 64 credits (GRAND TOTAL CREDITS: 64). Credits used are the sheet's 'Total Cr.' per course. Currency note: a newer sheet exists (Fall/2021 - Spring/2023, Rev.04/21) but is internally inconsistent - its Semester II courses sum to 13 cr against a declared 16 and its Semester III courses sum to 20 cr against a declared 17 - so this plan uses the internally consistent Rev.07/19 sheet; this is documented, not guessed. CD101 Career Development Seminar is a required 0-credit course (marked required_zero). Prerequisite honesty: developmental prerequisites (ENG108, ENG108L, MAT109, MAT109L) name real Vaughn courses but are not part of this sequence, so they are omitted rather than recorded against courses in the plan. Corequisite lab courses (FLT110L, FLT120L, PHY120L) are not separate courses; their credit is included in the lecture course's total as published, and prereq lists keep only the in-plan lecture course. The two fourth-semester elective slots ('Aviation, Management, Engineering, Technology' and 'Flight', 3 cr each) are choice courses. Category mapping: general-education competency courses (ENG, MAT, HIS141, POL254, FYI101) = core; flight courses = major. No courses invented.
